//==
// # IProcedural motion and paths
//
// Motion generated by a function rather than by keys: periodic oscillators,
// seeded fractal wiggle, camera shake, and placement along a 2D or 3D path.
// Seeded effects replay identically for equal seeds.

// The waveform of a procedural oscillator; Noise is smooth pseudo-random.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waveform)
type OscillatorWaveform = Sine | Square | Triangle | Sawtooth | Noise;
